findings.why: The dated progression stops three cases short of the candidate tree: the frozen round-18 counter's own pattern on tools/mutate-and-run.sh@9cf0146b reads recorded_cases=10 (depth_score=10; legs js-kimi-census, bash-surface-census, bash-tsukuroi-census, bash-mado-verify, bash-checklist-run, js-claims-check, js-round-gate, js-sources-check, js-cite-check, bash-drift-pins), while the section tells the reader the limit is seven. 'six at this write' is correct for the round-15 landing (9f2c86f and 0494c24 both measure 6) and 'seven since round 16' is correct at round-16 head (017a2b0 measures 7), but the parenthetical was already one short when this paragraph was last written at 5b703c6 (round-53, measured 10 there) and is three short at C0: rounds 18, 53 and later added js-sources-check, js-cite-check and bash-drift-pins without moving this milestone. A registry reader budgeting against 'the recorded cases' therefore under-counts the ledger by three in a section that otherwise resolves exactly.
